title: Sega Ages: Shukudai ga Tanto R
native_title: セガエイジス 宿題がタントアール
overview:
Concentrate! Rack your brains! A challenge to your intellect!! A double attack of variety games and quizzes!

The first Sega Ages volume pairs two Sega arcade games on one disc for one or two players.

In Puzzle & Action: Tant-R, detectives Robo and Mobo chase an escaped crook known as the Boss and his henchmen, who block the way with all kinds of puzzles. Clear quick timed mini-games - spotting the right item, counting, memorizing and button-timing challenges - to close in and make the arrest.

Quiz Shukudai o Wasuremashita! is a multiple-choice quiz that serves up nostalgic questions matched to the player's age.

- 17 simple, fast-paced mini-games
- Age-based quiz questions, with new questions added
- 1-2 players
